resources.string: MPV: broadest format support and styled ASS subtitles.
Native Apple pipeline: Dolby Vision, HDR10+, Dolby Atmos and lossless audio.
Hand playback to another app installed on this device.
TrueHD, DTS and other codecs Apple cannot play are converted to E-AC-3 5.1. Works with every TV, soundbar and headphones.
TrueHD, DTS-HD MA and others are decoded bit-perfect up to 7.1. Needs an HDMI or eARC receiver for surround; legacy ARC falls back to stereo.
AAC, AC-3, E-AC-3 (Dolby Atmos), FLAC and ALAC are always passed through untouched.
TrueHD Atmos and DTS:X play their 7.1 channel core.
Render the objects and height channels into your speaker layout: lossless PCM, or Apple Positional Audio over AirPlay.
Always deliver the rendered bed as 24-bit PCM.
Always deliver it as APAC: spatial audio on AirPods, Atmos over AirPlay. iOS 26 or later.
Dolby Vision whenever the profile and the display support it (profiles 5, 7, 8.1, 8.4 and AV1 10).
Ignore the Dolby Vision layer and play the HDR10 or HLG base. Fixes files with green or purple colours.
Compose UHD Blu-ray dual-layer Dolby Vision on the GPU instead of converting it to profile 8.1. Heavier, and E-AC-3 Atmos then plays as its channel bed.
Briefly decode audio tracks in the background so Dolby Atmos (E-AC-3 JOC) tracks are labelled.
VideoToolbox hardware decoding, software only for formats the hardware cannot play.
Force FFmpeg / dav1d decoding. Only for files that fail to play otherwise.
Also publish text subtitles as native tracks so they appear in Picture in Picture and on AirPlay screens.
